audit.whatIsWrong: diffRating and carryRating were empty strings while breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both state 6/10 and 6/10.
audit.why: The rating fields drive the badge; leaving them blank contradicts the prose that is already on the page. These are enum fields and exempt from the length band.
audit.corrected: diffRating '6/10', carryRating '6/10' — matching the existing prose, not a new judgement.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with itself, with the packet, and with the win rate. win[3]/phases[3].side said 'Volibear' while whys[3] and phases[3].why both say Dr. Mundo is favoured; win[5] said Volibear while whys[5] says Dr. Mundo; win[0] said 'Skill' while whys[0] says Volibear-favoured.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Volibear, Volibear, Volibear, Dr. Mundo, Volibear, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo], and at 55.88% over 961 games a Dr. Mundo-favoured back half is what the data supports. The why-text was already right on every disputed row; only the side token was wrong.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one atomic group across both layers: L1 Volibear, L2 Volibear, L3 Volibear, L4-5 Dr. Mundo, L6 Volibear, First item Dr. Mundo, 2+ items Dr. Mundo.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] told the player to 'Save E Blunt Force Trauma to interrupt his Q Thundering Smash'. Dr. Mundo's E has no interrupt: it is a damage auto-reset that only swats the target if the hit kills them.
audit.why: Fabricated interrupt. There is nothing in Dr. Mundo's kit that stops Thundering Smash — you eat the stun, and your passive cannister absorbs it once. Separately, Sky Splitter (E) shields Volibear ONLY if he is standing inside the blast radius, on a flat 16s cooldown at every rank, and that shield is what eats your commit.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2] retargeted to punishing the end of the stun; Sky Splitter's shield condition and 16s flat cooldown added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], report[11] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] gave Thundering Smash a 7s cooldown.
audit.why: Riot data has it at 12/11.5/11/10.5/10. A player told '7s' will step up five seconds too early. It also carries an auto-attack reset, so the wind-up — not the cast — is the tell.
audit.corrected: 12s at rank 1, 10s maxed, plus the auto-reset tell.

audit.why: Frenzied Maul applies on-hit and scales with the attack speed his passive stacks, so armour alone misreads the trade — report[8] already prescribes Plated Steelcaps and Thornmail, and wants.you[0] already names anti-heal for the W recast heal. No change needed.

edits.after: Save E Blunt Force Trauma to punish the instant his Q stun ends

edits.after: Your first tank item plus R sustain out-lasts his W once his early lead fades — Sky Splitter is a flat 16s, so trade in its downtime and his shield is not there.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash (Stun) (7s): matchup-defining — His engage. Bait it before committing. Track it before every commit. - Your ultimate: spend it on kill windows, never on waves. - Summoners: track his Flash after any close call — it changes every dive call.
edits.after: - Volibear Thundering Smash (12s at rank 1, 10s maxed): his engage, and it resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. - Sky Splitter (flat 16s): only shields him if he stands inside his own blast. - Your ultimate: kill windows only. - Track his Flash.

edits.after: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1 and resets his auto — and Sky Splitter shields him only if he stands in his own blast.

edits.after: Fight his level-3 all-in. Extend into his W heal, which applies on-hit and heals him on the recast. Commit into a fresh Sky Splitter shield.

notes: The level chart was internally contradictory: three rows carried a 'Volibear' side token above a why-line that explicitly said Dr. Mundo was favoured. All seven rows are proposed together as one atomic group, aligned to packet.levelChart. Also killed a fabricated interrupt — Dr. Mundo's E does not stop Thundering Smash. Sky Splitter's conditional shield (he must stand in the blast) and its flat 16s cooldown were absent from the whole page and are the most useful new fact here.
